# hackerone_scope_exclusions (Data Source)

Lists all scope exclusions (out-of-scope entries) for a HackerOne program.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `program_id` (String) Numeric ID of the program.

### Read-Only

- `exclusions` (Attributes List) All scope exclusions for the program, in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclusions))

<a id="nestedatt--exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exclusions`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Exclusion category.
- `details` (String) Exclusion details.
- `id` (String) Scope exclusion ID.
